pages.text: $(br2)$(bold)Radiant Chest$() $(l:blocks/radiant_chest)Radiant Chests$() make use of Quark's inventory search bar, and its Sort, Deposit, Merge, Extract, and Restock buttons.
pages.title: Inventory Management

pages.text: $(bold)Brazier of Hoarding$() Items marked as favorites will not be deposited into a $(l:blocks/brazier_hoarding)Brazier of Hoarding$() on right click. Favorited items can still be inserted into a Brazier of Hoarding when thrown.
